title: garments
description: What bodies wear, as garments a person would name (tunic, leggings, boots), each the body geometry it switches on plus the textures it samples, with the source items they were cut from and named outfits (REFACTOR/GARMENTS.md). Source items are packaging: one item can make several garments and one garment can draw pieces from several items. Inline in one model's garments reference it lists what that model's presets wear.

$schema.description: The schema this document follows, by its `$id`: the last path segment names the file in husk's schema/ directory, and schema_version says which version of it (REFACTOR/BUNDLE_FORMAT.md "The contract header").

schema_version.description: Version of the schema this document conforms to.

subject.description: The list; it has no identity of its own.

space.description: Units and axes of every value in the document.

definition.description: A list defines nothing beyond its entries; the body vocabulary its pieces name is the wearing model's definition.body.

selection.description: A list selects nothing; a model's presets choose the garments they wear.

references.description: Documents the entries point at; empty in an inline list, whose piece models are the embedding model's references.

items.description: One garment: what it is, where it stacks, and its pieces.

id.description: Stable id from the source identity the garment was cut from and its kind (REFACTOR/BUNDLE_FORMAT.md "Stable ids"); presets, source items and outfits point at it.

kind.description: What a person would call it. An open string: x-preset-kinds lists the validated kinds with their default layer, and a kind off that list is a warning, a known one when the garment says `deviates`.

layer.description: Stacking layer, bottom up in the listed order. Overlays composite bottom-up by layer, and where two garments set the same body part the higher layer wins; this replaces the source's slot priorities.

order.description: Stacking order within the layer, lower first. Garments of one layer and order that overlap in coverage are a conflict a consumer resolves by giving one another order; the format never picks.

deviates.description: True: the kind, layer or order differs from the kind's preset on purpose, so the validator reports it as a known warning.

pieces.description: What the garment consists of. Every piece of every source item lands in exactly one garment, so wearing a source item's garments reproduces it.

items.description: One piece: exactly one of overlay, geometry, attached, skinned, hides.

item.description: The id of the source item the piece was cut from.

rule.description: The derivation rule that put the piece in this garment (REFACTOR/BUNDLE_FORMAT.md derived-rule table).

overlay.description: A texture painted onto a body region of the composited skin.

region.description: The body region, a name of the wearing model's definition.body.regions.

texture.description: The texture, the wearer's race and sex file (rule component_file_pick), drawn into the region's rectangle.

mask.description: Which of the texture's pixels belong to this garment, white on black at the region's rectangle size; absent: all of them. A body hem's mask is the hem geoset's UV footprint (rule hem_uv_footprint).

geometry.description: A body part variant the garment switches on.

part.description: The body part, a name of the wearing model's definition.body.parts.

geoset.description: The variant shown: group * 100 + 1 + the display's value for the slot's group index (rule item_geoset).

attached.description: A rigid model hung at an attachment point (helm, pauldron, weapon).

point.description: The attachment point, a name of the wearing model's definition.body.attachment_points.

model.description: The picked model (rule component_file_pick); uri, when set, is its bundle, also listed in the model's references.

unresolved_reason.description: Why no file was picked: the wearer is unknown, several files fit equally, or none fits.

skinned.description: A model deformed by the body skeleton (a collection model), showing some of its own geosets.

model.description: The picked model (rule component_file_pick); uri, when set, is its bundle, also listed in the model's references.

unresolved_reason.description: Why no file was picked: the wearer is unknown, several files fit equally, or none fits.

shown_geosets.description: The model's geosets this piece shows; every other geoset of the model is hidden. A model's group-13 geoset is a hem piece of its own (rule item_model_hem), so the rest of the model is shown without it.

hides.description: A body part the garment hides (a helm's hair and ears).

source.description: The piece in the source's terms, as stored.

geoset_group_index.description: The GeosetGroup index the variant comes from, as stored.

model_position.description: The ModelResourcesID index, as stored; on shoulders 0 is the left model, 1 the right.

items.description: The source items the garments were cut from (the source's packaging), each once: wearing an item's garments is wearing the item exactly.

id.description: Stable id from the item's source row.

ref.description: The item: an ItemModifiedAppearance row (--appearance gear) or an ItemDisplayInfo row (NPC equipment).

garments.description: The garments holding the item's pieces: what wearing this item exactly means.

source.description: The item's place in the source, as stored.

slot.description: The equipment slot's name, lower case.

item_slot.description: The source's slot number, as stored (NPC equipment).

slot_token.description: The --appearance file's own slot name, as given.

item_display_info.description: The display row the item resolved to, as stored.

outfits.description: Named groups of garments (a transmog set); wearing an outfit is wearing its garments, and a consumer can swap one and keep the rest.

id.description: Stable id from the outfit's source row.

garments.description: The garments of the outfit's source items that this list holds.

source.description: The outfit in the source's terms.

resources.description: Data the pieces use by id.

textures.description: Every texture a piece uses, each once.

piece_textures.description: An item model's textures, each the wearer's race and sex file (rule component_file_pick).

role.description: The model texture slot it fills, named as texture slots are (rule texture_slot_name).

source.description: The texture in the source's terms, as stored.

texture_type.description: The item model's M2 texture type it fills, as stored.

model_position.description: The model position it textures, as stored.
